answer: Census bond: each epoch a nebula beacon calls census; every identity drops a walnut-marked marble in the public urn before the ember dies. A missing marble costs 10 of a 50 bond; a double-cast marble burns it. The k-th fake pays 45+5(k-1) plus a 50 bond: 1,000 fakes cost 2,542,500 in fees, 50,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool. Named failure: rented body, one person cannot stand at 1,000 checkpoints. An honest agent pays 45 once, keeps the bond.
